svg.title: IPC Uploader
svg.desc: An engineer fills in the form in the browser; the IPC Uploader on their PC zips the reports and copies the zip over FTP into the IPC server's Inbox, recording the upload in its own SQLite file and in the shared PostgreSQL database. The hourly AI proof check (not in this repo) puts the result in the Outbox, where the app finds it and offers it for download. On an office screen, the IPC Check Queue page reads the same uploads from BackendAPI, which reads PostgreSQL. an upload: Engineer's browser → IPC_uploader_frontend.py → code_finder.py → 01 - Inbox, PostgreSQL. the queue: PostgreSQL → BackendAPI.py → IPC Check Queue. a result: 02 - Outbox → code_finder.py → IPC_uploader_frontend.py → Engineer's browser.
